description: FREQROL-D700 compact inverter with Modbus RTU on the PU connector
source: Mitsubishi Electric FR-D700 Instruction Manual (Applied) IB(NA)-0600366ENG, MODBUS RTU communication
notes: The manual numbers the registers 40001 and up; this map uses address_base 1, so address 201 is register 40201 and goes on the wire as 200.

Registers: 40002 to 40015 are the system environment variables, 40201 and up the real-time monitor, 41000 plus the parameter number the parameters (Pr. 1 is 41001), and 40501 to 40508 the fault history.

Register 40009 holds the control input instruction when written and the inverter status when read; 40010 sets the operation mode when written and gives the mode status when read, so each is listed twice with a different access.
Write the running frequency to 40014 (RAM) for continuous changes and to 40015 (EEPROM) only for values to keep; the EEPROM has a limited number of writes.
The inverter must be in NET operation mode to accept commands from communications (Pr. 79, Pr. 340); Pr. 549 = 1 selects MODBUS RTU and the PU connector is the RS-485 port.

Some monitor registers are not available on inverters made before a certain date (the manual marks 40208 to 40212, 40214, 40220, 40223 to 40225, 40252 to 40254 and 40261 to 40264 with a footnote about the assembly date), and the monitored values are kept after a fault until reset.

Pr. 118 = 192 (19200 bit/s) and Pr. 120 = 2 (even parity, 1 stop bit) are the factory values. The factory station number Pr. 117 = 0 is broadcast and the inverter does not answer, so the unit_id here is 1, which must be set in Pr. 117.
With Pr. 549 = 1 and Pr. 118 = 384 the FR-PU04 and FR-PU07 parameter units stop working.

stop_mode.2: Decelerate to stop, no fault output

registers.name: Inverter reset
registers.description: Write any value to reset the inverter

registers.name: Parameter clear
registers.description: Write 0x965A; the communication parameters are not cleared

registers.name: All parameter clear
registers.description: Write 0x99AA

registers.name: Parameter clear (alternative)
registers.description: Write 0x5A96

registers.name: All parameter clear (alternative)
registers.description: Write 0xAA99

registers.name: Control input instruction
registers.description: Written value; bit 0 stop, 1 forward (STF), 2 reverse (STR), 3 RH, 4 RM, 5 RL, 7 second function, 8 terminal 4 selection, 10 output stop (MRS). Reading the same register gives the inverter status

registers.name: RH high-speed command
registers.description: Write; takes the function set by Pr. 180 to Pr. 182

registers.name: RM middle-speed command
registers.description: Write; takes the function set by Pr. 180 to Pr. 182

registers.name: RL low-speed command
registers.description: Write; takes the function set by Pr. 180 to Pr. 182

registers.name: Running (RUN)
registers.description: Variable, by Pr. 190, Pr. 192, Pr. 197

registers.name: Alarm output (ABC)
registers.description: Variable

registers.name: Safety monitor output (SO)
registers.description: Variable

registers.name: Operation mode status
registers.description: Read value; write the operation mode with the register below

registers.name: Operation mode setting
registers.description: Writing is limited by Pr. 79 and Pr. 340

registers.name: Running frequency (RAM)
registers.description: Written to RAM; the unit is 1 r/min when Pr. 37 is set to a value other than 0

registers.name: Running frequency (EEPROM)
registers.description: Written to EEPROM; same unit as register 14

registers.name: Output frequency/speed
registers.description: 1 r/min when Pr. 37 is set

registers.name: Output frequency setting/speed setting
registers.description: 1 r/min when Pr. 37 is set

registers.name: Input STF
registers.description: Input terminal status

registers.name: Input STR
registers.description: Input terminal status

registers.name: Input RL
registers.description: Input terminal status; function assigned by Pr. 178 to Pr. 182

registers.name: Input RM
registers.description: Input terminal status; function assigned by Pr. 178 to Pr. 182

registers.name: Input RH
registers.description: Input terminal status; function assigned by Pr. 178 to Pr. 182

registers.name: Output RUN
registers.description: Output terminal status; function set by Pr. 190, Pr. 192, Pr. 197

registers.name: Output ABC
registers.description: Output terminal status; function set by Pr. 190, Pr. 192, Pr. 197

registers.name: Output SO
registers.description: Output terminal status; function set by Pr. 190, Pr. 192, Pr. 197

registers.name: Fault record 1 (latest)
registers.description: Low byte is the error code; writing any value to this register clears the whole fault history

registers.name: Parameter write selection (Pr. 77)
registers.description: 0 = write only when stopped, 1 = no write, 2 = write in any mode

registers.name: Reverse rotation prevention (Pr. 78)
registers.description: 0 = both directions, 1 = reverse prevented, 2 = forward prevented

registers.name: Operation mode selection (Pr. 79)
registers.description: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 are valid

registers.name: PU communication station number (Pr. 117)
registers.description: 0 = no reply (broadcast)

registers.name: PU communication speed (Pr. 118)
registers.description: Setting x 100 = bit/s

registers.name: PU communication check time interval (Pr. 122)
registers.description: 0 = communication allowed but E.PUE on switching to the command source; 0.1 to 999.8 s = signal-loss time; 9999 = no check

registers.name: Protocol selection (Pr. 549)
registers.description: Set to 1 for MODBUS RTU; takes effect after a reset
